description: Main macOS shell provides a stable sidebar-detail experience with dashboard, calculator selection, help, preferences, and new-calculation flows.
steps: Launch the app and confirm the main window appears with native macOS navigation.
Select dashboard and multiple calculator categories from the sidebar.
Open and dismiss the new calculation sheet, preferences, and help surfaces.
Verify selection changes update the detail pane without broken states.

description: Dashboard surfaces honest statistics, recent activity, and quick actions without misleading mock-live claims.
steps: Open the dashboard after launch.
Review summary cards, quick actions, and recent activity.
Trigger a quick action and confirm it routes to the intended calculator.
Verify any market or activity surfaces clearly reflect real or mock data truthfully.

description: Time Value of Money calculator accurately solves PV, FV, PMT, rate, and number of years with clear validation and charting.
steps: Open the Time Value calculator.
Enter four of the five required variables and choose a target variable.
Run the calculation and verify the result and explanation.
Confirm chart data and validation errors behave correctly.

description: Loan and mortgage workflows calculate payments, amortization, payoff changes, and insights accurately.
steps: Open the loan or mortgage calculator.
Enter principal, rate, term, and optional down payment or extra payment.
Verify payment summary, amortization schedule, and payoff insights.
Confirm editing inputs updates results consistently.

description: Bond analysis supports price and yield workflows with cash-flow and sensitivity views.
steps: Open the bond calculator.
Switch between price and yield modes.
Enter face value, coupon, maturity, and market inputs.
Verify result, supporting metrics, and chart/table outputs.

description: Investment analysis handles NPV, IRR, cash-flow editing, and scenario/sensitivity analysis accurately.
steps: Open the investment calculator.
Enter an initial investment and a series of cash flows.
Run NPV, IRR, and combined analysis modes.
Verify the supporting analysis views use the same underlying data correctly.

description: Options calculator prices calls and puts, reports Greeks, and uses non-placeholder sensitivity analysis.
steps: Open the options calculator.
Enter spot price, strike, expiry, rate, volatility, and option type.
Verify the premium and Greeks are generated.
Confirm any analysis view is implemented and not labeled as a placeholder.

description: Depreciation calculator supports straight-line, declining-balance, sum-of-years-digits, and MACRS workflows with schedules.
steps: Open the depreciation calculator.
Enter asset cost, salvage value, life, year, and method-specific inputs.
Run each supported method and verify the current-year result.
Review schedule and comparison outputs for correctness.

description: Currency converter supports reliable conversions, honest rate sourcing, and history persistence.
steps: Open the currency converter.
Convert between two currencies using the displayed rate source.
Save the conversion and reopen history.
Delete or favorite a saved conversion and verify the state persists.

description: Unit converter supports multiple categories, quick conversions, and history management.
steps: Open the unit converter.
Choose a unit category and convert between supported units.
Verify quick conversions and saved history entries.
Confirm conversion results remain correct after input edits.

description: Math expression evaluator supports variables, example expressions, and trustworthy calculation history.
steps: Open the math expression calculator.
Enter an expression with variables and provide values for those variables.
Evaluate the expression and verify the result uses the supplied variables.
Save or recall the expression from history.

description: Saved calculations, favorites, search, recent history, and delete/edit flows work consistently across supported calculation types.
steps: Create representative calculations in multiple calculators.
Mark one as a favorite and verify it appears in filtered views.
Search for a saved calculation by name or note.
Delete a saved calculation and confirm it no longer appears in recents or dashboard summaries.

description: Preferences, help, keyboard affordances, and desktop presentation are polished and truthful.
steps: Open preferences and modify formatting or currency settings.
Close and relaunch the app to confirm preferences persist.
Open help and verify it reflects actual supported functionality.
Use toolbar and keyboard-accessible paths for primary actions.

description: Import/export and reporting flows work for supported calculation data and are documented accurately.
steps: Create a calculation and invoke export from the app.
Verify the exported content contains the expected data.
Import supported data back into the app when applicable.
Confirm README instructions match the implemented flow.

description: The app includes at least one new high-value planning workflow beyond the original foundation, such as retirement planning or advanced savings analysis.
steps: Discover the new planning tool from the app navigation.
Enter representative planning inputs.
Review projections, summary metrics, and explanatory guidance.
Save the result and verify it participates in the same persistence and documentation flows as other calculators.
